consent.modal_title: Clinical AI Health Coach Disclosure & Consent
consent.intro: Disha AI aapki personal lifestyle, nutrition, aur habit health coach hai.
consent.not_doctor: Disha ek artificial intelligence health coach hai, koi certified medical doctor ya practitioner nahi.
consent.no_prescription: Disha kisi bimari ko diagnose nahi karti aur na hi medicines prescribe ya change karti hai.
consent.emergency: Agar chest pain, breathlessness, ya koi acute emergency ho, toh turant 112 ya 108 par call karein.
consent.voice_processing: Audio ko speech-to-text processing ke liye use kiya jata hai taaki conversation smooth ho sake.
consent.checkbox: Main samajhta/samajhti hoon ki Disha ek AI health coach hai aur voice consultation ki consent deta/deti hoon.

onboarding.welcome_message:
Namaste {name}! Main Disha hoon, aapki personal AI health coach. Main lifestyle, diet aur healthy habits mein aapko guide karti hoon. Main ek doctor nahi hoon aur emergency medical treatment nahi de sakti.

Aaj aap kaisa mehsoos kar rahe hain? Kya aap aaj ka nutrition plan dekhna chahenge ya wellness goals par baat karein?
